biggest_cut: The step-by-step finite-energy edge-modification argument (with its three bullet lists) in the proof of Proposition 33 could be replaced by one sentence saying that a standard finite-energy argument gives (23). Other cuttable material: the side remarks (Remarks 11, 28, 32 and Corollary 6), the Proposition 13 'only if' direction, which the main proof never uses, and the repeated full hypothesis lists in Theorems 3/4/7 and Corollaries 5/6.
